answer.text: Obtain details of their portfolio from the portfolio manager

explanation.text: The Logic: The client has the right to obtain portfolio details from the portfolio manager, who must provide client reports periodically and as and when required by the client. The Trap: Clients cannot dilute regulatory requirements, skip risk profiling, or compel disclosures beyond SEBI's framework. Note: The reporting duty is codified — periodic plus on-demand reporting to the client.
